items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I took Ella to see Ethel Waters, Cabin In The Sky.

ctx.x: I took Ella to see Ethel Waters, Cabin In The Sky. She never had been to see no show.
I used to take her to see all these shows. I say, "I'm going to take you to see Ethel Waters. You'll see Cabin In The Sky."
